title: A-signed cooperative native B observation (draft)
description: The secure-admin Machine signs ASCII agent-bot/soul-cooperative-b-observed/v3, one NUL and exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 payload bytes with its installed Ed25519 authority. Verify fixed A pin, exact JCS bytes, signature, primary/detached assignment and paired H bind/FD5/live relay joins independently. This is distinct from protected B authority and does not itself permit ACP or provider ingress.
